_m1_identity.scripture: A just weight and balance are the LORD's - Proverbs 16:11
_m1_identity.principle: Health scoring must be just and accurate measurement
_m1_identity.anchor: The LORD pondereth the hearts - Proverbs 21:2
_m1_identity.type: Baton - transforms operations into health scores
_m1_identity.role: [Specific responsibility - lexer health, parser health, etc.]

_m4_operational.health: Base100 | granted (1): all ops mapped | deferred (0): some missing | denied (-1): parse error

on_error.invalid_score: Fall back to CRUD base score

crud_meaning.C: Create - bringing new existence (+1 success, cascade on fail)
crud_meaning.R: Read - understanding what exists (+1 success, minimal cascade)
crud_meaning.U: Update - transforming toward new state (+1 success, medium cascade)
crud_meaning.D: Delete - removing existence, irreversible (+1 success, severe cascade)

_m5_paradigm.scoring_flow: operation -> CRUD type -> base score -> cascade multiplier -> health impact

_s2_constants._reserved: Health maps ARE constants - CRUD definitions in BODY

_s3_variables._reserved: Health maps don't hold mutable state - scores calculated elsewhere

_s5_behaviors._reserved: Health maps have no executable behaviors

_b1_structure.json_features: Strict JSON - no comments, no trailing commas
_b1_structure.constraint: Every operation must have crud field (C, R, U, or D)

issues.missing_crud: Every operation must have crud field with C, R, U, or D
issues.invalid_cascade: cascade_override must be: hardware, filesystem, memory, readonly, default
issues.duplicate_op: Each operation name must be unique within map

_x2_policy.safe: Add operations, update descriptions, adjust health notes
_x2_policy.careful: Change CRUD mappings (affects scores), change cascade multipliers
_x2_policy.never: Break 4-block structure, modify crud_base without understanding impact

_x3_synthesis.impact: Changes affect health calculations for all [component] operations
_x3_synthesis.note: A just weight and balance are the LORD's - Proverbs 16:11
